title: Ginger (Dry): modeled ₹498/qtl left, Naraingarh → Ladwa
summary: January 2024: reported ginger (Dry) prices at Naraingarh and Ladwa imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 81% of 27 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹498 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 30 same-variety market pairs screened for ginger (Dry) in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ladwa report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Ladwa (Haryana) both reported ginger (Dry) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 27 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹7,000 per quintal. Ladwa reported a median ₹8,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,500 per quintal, and Ladwa was dearer on 93% of days.

scenes.headline: 77 km by road
scenes.caption: 77 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹17/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹629 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹171 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ladwa report, the rule selects 22 of 27 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹498 per quintal (₹68 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ginger (Dry) route from Naraingarh to Ladwa was positive on 81% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹49,800, or ₹6,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to ginger (Dry)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹17/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Ginger (Dry) route from Naraingarh to Ladwa was positive on 81% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹49,800, or ₹6,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
